stem:
Meena learns in class that lemon contains citric acid and curd contains lactic acid. Foods containing these acids taste ……1…… .

Later, Meena finds an unlabelled bottle of liquid in the school laboratory. To check whether it is acidic, she ……2…… taste it.

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

teacher.key_rationale: Acids in foods such as lemon (citric acid) and curd (lactic acid) have a sour taste, so gap 1 is 'sour'. Unknown or unlabelled substances must never be tasted because taste is not a safe identification method, so gap 2 is 'must not'. Hence B. Option C is the trap for students who know acids are sour but drop the safety condition; A and D trap students who confuse sour with bitter.
